notes: Every server in one place: Valheim, Palworld, 7 Days to Die, Terraria and the others get the Dashboard, Console, Players, Server settings, Backups and Mods that Minecraft has.
A fresh coat: Games, Sites & apps and the Doctor open on a headline with their numbers, a game's page shows its own picture, and the sidebar's sections fold.
Fenrir Connect's Games page says where each game stands, with one button for what comes next, and Fenrir Link lists the sites and apps your PC hosts.
